{{Translated title|rom}} [[File:Yuto POKÉTOON.png|thumb|250px|Yūto]] (Japanese: '''ユウト''' ''Yūto'') is a character who appeared in [[PT16]]. He is a student at [[Naranja Academy]]. ==Pokémon== ===On hand=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Yūto |pkmn=Breloom |stage1=Shroomish |type1=Grass |type2=Fighting |img=Yuto Shroomish.png |cap=Yūto's Shroomish |img2=Yuto Breloom.png |epnum=PT16 |epname= |vajp=List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Yuuki Kazu |desc={{p|Breloom}} is Yūto's first known Pokémon. As a {{p|Shroomish}}, it was used to battle a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Charcadet}} in order to retrieve its Trainer's [[Rotom Phone]]. Later, as a Breloom, it was seen battling [[Kofu]]'s {{p|Crabominable}} and sparring against Charcadet. Breloom's only known move is {{m|Zen Headbutt}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Yūto |main=Yūto's Armarouge |pkmn=Armarouge |tera=Fire |stage1=Charcadet |type1=Fire |type2=Psychic |img=Yuto Armarouge.png |cap=Yūto's Armarouge |img2=Tulip PT.png |epnum=PT16 |epname= |vajp=List of Japanese voice actors{{!}}Yuki Sakakibara |desc={{p|Armarouge}} is Yūto's second known Pokémon. As a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Charcadet}}, it roamed [[Paldea]] alongside its friend, a {{Shiny}} Charcadet. One day, they found Yūto's [[Rotom Phone]], and Charcadet was captivated by the tournament depicted on-screen. Yūto challenged it to a battle in order to retrieve its phone and, after defeating it, invited Charcadet to his [[Party|team]], which it accepted, leaving its friend behind. During Yūto's battle against [[Kofu]], Charcadet sprung into battle and attacked the [[Gym Leader]]'s {{p|Crabominable}} without any warning but was quickly subdued. Yūto reached out to Charcadet, acknowledging its strengths and vowing to hone them. After Charcadet defeated Breloom in a training match, Yūto took it to a room containing a set of [[Auspicious Armor]] that had been passed down in his family and told it about a legend involving Charcadet. Feeling compelled by the armor, Charcadet touched it and evolved into Armarouge. Later, while waiting for Yūto's match in the battle tournament held in [[Mesagoza]], a Shiny {{p|Ceruledge}} appeared and quickly lunged at Armarouge, who did not take long before recognizing it as its childhood friend. They continued to clash until Ceruledge was unable to keep battling and then properly said their goodbyes, bringing closure to both of them as they followed different paths.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Yūto |pkmn=Quaquaval |stage1=Quaxwell |type1=Water |type2=Fighting |img=Yuto Quaxwell.png |cap=Yūto's Quaxwell |img2=Yuto Quaquaval.png |epnum=PT16 |epname= |vajp=Kohsuke Tanabe |desc={{p|Quaquaval}} is Yūto's third known Pokémon. It was first seen as a {{p|Quaxwell}}, watching its Trainer's match against [[Kofu]]. None of Quaquaval's moves are known.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Yūto |pkmn=Rufflet |gender=male |type1=Normal |type2=Flying |img=Yuto Rufflet.png |epnum=PT16 |epname= |vajp=Noriaki Kanze |desc={{p|Rufflet}} is Yūto's fourth known Pokémon.
